subject: Request: Geo payband holdback & equity adjudication for impacted contributor
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Geo payband holdback & equity adjudication for impacted contributor

Hi team —

I need a quick decision on a comp exception for an individual contributor on my org who moved locations mid-cycle and landed in a different pay geography. Context: Rohan Mehta (IC, Platform) was in APAC but relocated to the EU in January; his midcycle review landed after the relocation and the standard geo-banding is causing a significant merit reduction compared to peers. He is high-performing (attached perf packet) and the move was business-directed for a customer-critical project.

Ask: approve a one-time geo-holdback override so we can apply the original APAC merit percent and grant a modest equity refresh to maintain retention parity. Proposed package (simple):
- Merit: +7% (apply APAC band rather than EU band)
- Spot/bonus: standard target (no change)
- Equity refresh: one-time 0.05% refresh (RSU-like instrument)

Impacted systems: payroll needs a holdback flag and a ticket (attached). Proposed timing: catch in next payroll cycle (May 5).

Please advise if legal or finance sign-off required; Marcus, can you confirm the budget headcount/lag? Vivek, any objections from a org-design perspective? Laura, I’ve attached the performance packet and org-change memo for HR audit.

Thanks — I know this is time-sensitive as the manager has to communicate comp before next week.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Geo payband holdback & equity adjudication for impacted contributor

Thanks Tessa — received and reviewed attachments. A few quick clarifying items before HR can approve the holdback override: 

1) Written confirmation that the relocation was business-directed (manager note or product lead confirmation).
2) Confirmation that Rohan has not been offered any market-based uplift post-move.
3) Manager comms draft for transparency to team (we prefer a short note that avoids granular numbers).

If you can drop those in, I can fast-track a formal HR exception memo. Also tagging payroll for the ticket — payroll will need the exact compensation elements in a single flat CSV for processing.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: rohan.mehta@personalemail.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Geo payband holdback & equity adjudication for impacted contributor

Laura — attaching the manager confirmation and a short comms draft. Quick answers inline:

1) Relocation: business-directed — see org_change_memo.pdf (customer escalation required reassignment).
2) No market uplift has been applied since the move. The manager confirms no ad hoc increases.

Draft comms (for your convenience):
"Team — we recently had a business-directed relocation for a core engineering contributor. To ensure internal equity while the individual settles into the new geography, we are applying a one‑time compensation adjustment. This is a targeted, non-recurring measure and not a change to base pay bands. If you have questions, please reach out to hr@redwood.ai."

Attachments: rohan_perf_packet.pdf, org_change_memo.pdf, payroll_ticket_4821.pdf

If this is sufficient, can we route the formal memo to Finance for budget confirmation and then to Payroll for the May cycle?

—Tessa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Geo payband holdback & equity adjudication for impacted contributor

All — after reviewing the packet and the headcount bucket, Finance can support a one-time geo-holdback override under the following conditions: 

1) Equity refresh capped at 0.05% (approved) and delivered as an RSU grant with standard vesting schedule (no acceleration).
2) Merit can be applied at APAC percentage (approved) but must be explicitly documented as a non-base adjustment in the payroll notes.
3) Manager must sign the formal exception memo and confirm no other skipped increases in the role this cycle.
4) Payroll ticket must be submitted as a single CSV by end of day Monday (2027-04-26) to hit May payroll.

Laura — if HR issues the exception memo, Finance will send a confirmation email to payroll and queue the ledger entry. Tessa — please coordinate the manager note and the CSV.

Marcus
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
